🔥 ubuntu-cleaner | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: System cleaning and disk space optimization for Ubuntu operating systems.
✨ Key Features: • Clear browser cache • Clear APT cache • Clear thumbnail cache • Remove unneeded packages • Remove old kernels
📖 Summary: Ubuntu Cleaner is a Python-based tool designed to free up disk space and remove private information on Ubuntu systems. It offers a user-friendly way to clear various caches, uninstall unneeded packages, and remove old system components.
